description: Locked in-event rule encoding. Source, selection rule, and thresholds were locked pre-event in models/rule_specs.md; literal SMARTS/parameters are committed here with a decision-log row.

admet_rules.name: molecular_weight
admet_rules.source: Lipinski et al., Adv. Drug Deliv. Rev. 1997

admet_rules.name: rotatable_bonds
admet_rules.source: Veber et al., J. Med. Chem. 2002

pains_catalog.note: Exact SMARTS not inlined. The lock is on the source catalog set (RDKit PAINS_A/B/C), not on re-transcribed strings; runtime enumeration avoids transcription drift between the spec and the implementation.

aggregator_rules.name: long_aliphatic_chain
aggregator_rules.description: 12 or more consecutive sp3 CH2 groups. Common aggregator signature for amphiphilic detergents (Feng & Shoichet, Nat. Protoc. 2006).

aggregator_rules.name: amphiphilic_large
aggregator_rules.description: Both lipophilic (LogP > 3) and large (MW > 400). Complementary amphiphilicity heuristic from the same literature (Irwin et al., J. Med. Chem. 2015).
